title: The Summit of the Empty Quarter
author: Ansel Pemberton
blurb: Kestrel Kavanagh, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
